# SelfClassReferencing

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `SelfClassReferencingInspection`

Inside a class's own methods, refer to the class consistently: by default with
`self` (and `__CLASS__` instead of `Name::class`), which survives renames; or,
when `PREFER_CLASS_NAMES` is on, with the explicit class name instead of `self`
/ `__CLASS__`.

## Example

Default mode:

::: code-group

```php{6,8,9,10,11} [Before]
<?php
namespace Shop;

class Basket
{
    public function merge(Basket $other): ?Basket
    {
        $copy = new \Shop\Basket();
        $max  = Basket::LIMIT;
        if ($other instanceof Basket) {}
        log_event(Basket::class);

        $make = fn() => new Basket();          // inside arrow function: skipped
        $anon = new class() extends Basket {}; // extends clause: skipped
        return self::empty();
    }
}

trait Countable2
{
    public function who() { return Countable2::class; }   // trait: skipped
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
namespace Shop;

class Basket
{
    public function merge(self $other): ?self
    {
        $copy = new self();
        $max  = self::LIMIT;
        if ($other instanceof self) {}
        log_event(__CLASS__);

        $make = fn() => new Basket();          // inside arrow function: skipped
        $anon = new class() extends Basket {}; // extends clause: skipped
        return self::empty();
    }
}

trait Countable2
{
    public function who() { return Countable2::class; }   // trait: skipped
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 6: Refer to the class as &#39;self&#39; instead of &#39;Basket&#39;.</li>
<li>line 8: Refer to the class as &#39;self&#39; instead of &#39;Basket&#39;.</li>
<li>line 9: Refer to the class as &#39;self&#39; instead of &#39;Basket&#39;.</li>
<li>line 10: Refer to the class as &#39;self&#39; instead of &#39;Basket&#39;.</li>
<li>line 11: Refer to the class as &#39;__CLASS__&#39; instead of &#39;Basket::class&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| PREFER_CLASS_NAMES | bool | false | Switches the preferred style: false = use `self`/`__CLASS__`; true = use the explicit class name / `Name::class`. |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SelfClassReferencing": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "PREFER_CLASS_NAMES": false
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SelfClassReferencing

/**
 * @noinspection SelfClassReferencingInspection
 */
```
